title: Ekka: Automated Diagnosis of Silent Errors in LLM Inference
abstract: arXiv:2606.04594v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: LLM serving frameworks are quickly evolving with a complex software stack and a vast number of optimizations. The rapid development process can introduce silent errors where output quality silently degrades without any explicit error signals. Diagnosing silent errors is notoriously difficult due to the substantial semantic gap between the high-level symptoms and the low-level root causes. We observe that diagnosis of silent errors can be effectively framed as a differential debugging problem by leveraging the existence of semantically correct reference implementations. We propose Ekka, an automated diagnosis system that identifies root causes by systematically aligning and comparing intermediate execution states between a target and a reference framework. We constructed a benchmark of real-world silent errors from popular serving frameworks, where Ekka shows 80% pass@1 diagnosis accuracy and 88% pass@5 diagnosis accuracy, outpe

translated_title: Ekka：LLM推理中静默错误的自动化诊断
translated_abstract: LLM服务框架正快速演进，形成了复杂的软件栈和大量的优化技术。快速的开发过程可能引入静默错误，即输出质量在没有任何显式错误信号的情况下悄然下降。由于高层症状与低层根本原因之间存在巨大的语义鸿沟，诊断这类静默错误是非常困难的。我们观察到，通过利用语义正确的参考实现，静默错误的诊断可以有效地转化为一个差分调试问题。我们提出了Ekka，一个自动化诊断系统，它通过系统地对比和对齐目标框架与参考框架之间的中间执行状态来识别根本原因。我们基于流行的服务框架构建了一个真实世界静默错误基准，Ekka在其中展现出80%的pass@1诊断准确率和88%的pass@5诊断准确率，超越了现有方法。
tldr: Ekka通过差分对比目标与参考LLM服务框架的中间执行状态，将静默错误诊断转化为差分调试问题，实现了自动化的根因定位，在真实错误基准上达到80%的pass@1诊断准确率。
en_tdlr: Ekka is an automated diagnosis system that identifies root causes of silent errors in LLM serving frameworks by framing diagnosis as differential debugging—systematically aligning and comparing intermediate execution states against a reference implementation—achieving 80% pass@1 and 88% pass@5 diagnosis accuracy on a benchmark of real-world errors.
